# Decision to separate reclaim shades

## Decision
Keep pale and dark offcuts in separate reclaim streams. Controlled shade comparison exercises in this fictional record attributed unstable pale-panel appearance to unknown proportions of dark offcuts in the common stream. Separation preserves a known input family and makes unexplained shade changes easier to investigate.

## Consequences
The decision retires common bin C as a destination. It does not define current bin labels, handling tools or transfer records; those belong to the maintained reclaim-streams sheet. This record contains synthetic rationale rather than measured evidence from a real factory.
